## DPStyleARWatchRendererInput class

Renderer input model for watch virtual try-on. Extends the base item renderer input with wrist-side information so the renderer can place the watch on the correct hand.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class DPStyleARWatchRendererInput extends DPStyleARItemRendererInput 
```
**Extends:** [DPStyleARItemRendererInput](./stylearweblive.dpstylearitemrendererinput.md)
